## Get to know about me

Hi, I'm Changshen (Tony) Chen. I am a first-year Master of Science student in Biostatistics at Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health, and I completed my Bachelor of Science in Quantitative Biology at the University of Southern California

I work with clinical and genomic data primarily in R and Python, and I am building SAS and SQL proficiency through coursework at Columbia. My interests are survival analysis and predictive modeling, and I am looking for biostatistics/data scientist roles in the pharmaceutical and life sciences industry.

You can reach me through the GitHub, email, and LinkedIn icons at the top of the page.
